digest.lead: The big story today is Amazon CEO discussions triggering a U.S. crackdown on Anthropic models, drawing intense community scrutiny with hundreds of comments on Hacker News.
digest.summary: Meanwhile, Anthropic quietly released Claude Fable 5 Mythos 5, though details remain sparse.

stories.headline: Amazon CEO Discussions Lead to U.S. Government Crackdown on Anthropic Models
stories.summary: Conversations between Amazon's CEO and U.S. officials have reportedly triggered government action against Anthropic's AI models [1]. The news has generated significant discussion in the tech community, with nearly 500 comments on Hacker News reflecting widespread concern about regulatory overreach and its implications for AI development [1].
key_points: Amazon CEO's communications with officials directly led to regulatory action
Story has attracted intense community attention with 664 upvotes and 490 comments
stories.impact: This regulatory development could significantly impact Anthropic's operations and set precedent for government intervention in AI companies, particularly affecting enterprise customers and developers relying on Claude models.

sources.title: Amazon CEO's talks with U.S. officials triggered crackdown on Anthropic models

stories.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5 Mythos 5
stories.summary: Anthropic has announced the release of Claude Fable 5 Mythos 5, though the company has provided minimal details about the new model's capabilities or improvements [2].
stories.impact: The sparse announcement leaves developers and users uncertain about what improvements or new features this model iteration brings to the Claude ecosystem.

stories.headline: Use `/code-review --fix` to automatically apply review findings
stories.summary: Instead of manually implementing code review suggestions, this command automatically applies reuse, simplification, and efficiency improvements to your working tree. This streamlines the code review process by eliminating the manual step of implementing suggested changes.
actionable_steps: Review the automatically applied changes in your working tree
Verify the improvements match your expectations

stories.headline: Use visual mode in Claude Code for text selection and editing
stories.summary: Claude Code now supports vim-style visual mode (v) and visual-line mode (V) for selecting and manipulating text. This enables more efficient text editing workflows similar to vim editors.
actionable_steps: Press 'v' to enter visual mode for character-by-character selection
Press 'V' to enter visual-line mode for line-by-line selection
Use standard vim operators on your selected text

stories.headline: Use claude project purge to clean up Claude Code project state
stories.summary: The new purge command removes all Claude Code artifacts for a project including transcripts, tasks, file history, and config entries. This is useful for cleaning up projects or starting fresh without manual file deletion.
actionable_steps: Run 'claude project purge [path]' to delete all Claude Code state for a project
Use '--dry-run' flag first to preview what will be deleted
Add '-y' or '--yes' to skip confirmation prompts, or '-i' for interactive mode

stories.headline: Configure fallback models for better reliability when primary model fails
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.166 introduced a fallbackModel setting that lets you specify up to three backup models that will be tried in order when your primary model is overloaded or unavailable. This prevents workflow interruptions during high-traffic periods.
actionable_steps: Update Claude Code to version 2.1.166 or later
Add 'fallbackModel' setting to your configuration with up to 3 model names in priority order
Use '--fallback-model' flag when starting interactive sessions to apply fallbacks
Test the configuration by temporarily blocking access to your primary model

stories.headline: Enable PowerShell tool for Windows development workflows
stories.summary: Claude Code now includes an opt-in PowerShell tool that allows Windows users to execute PowerShell commands directly through Claude. This provides native Windows command-line access for system administration and development tasks.
actionable_steps: Update Claude Code to version 2.1.84 or later
Enable the PowerShell tool in your settings as a preview feature
